title: Supplier Prequalification Notice 2026-2027
description: Akiba Commercial Bank PLC supplier prequalification for 40 categories including ICT equipment, office supplies, construction, consultancy, and various services. Conducted online via TenderSure platform at https://www.tendersure.africa/
eligibility: Interested suppliers register via TenderSure platform; TSH 100,000 non-refundable fee per category. Contact help@tendersure.africa or WhatsApp +255 741914924.
